decisions.reason: The digital twin service remains an emerging-market option with uncertain demand, and its continuation cost is still acceptable compared with the option value.
The authentication and identity delegation service has low marginal cost and its prospects are still unresolved, so the option is retained for now.
The open GIS framework is central to the firm's component strategy and has low continuation costs, making the option value high.
The identity service for GIS applications is close to the established offer and has low incremental cost, so the firm keeps the option open.
The consulting workshop is a low-cost option that can reveal demand for geodata business process services, so it is worth keeping while uncertainty remains.
